# Examples for recomputing the recipes

All numbers in examples/ are invented and say nothing about markets, products or the future; do not report them as results of a strategy.

This repository neither contains nor names market, index or product data.

Each package under examples/ has four files: input.csv, recompute.py, output.csv and README.md. The README describes the recipe in numbered steps. The file output.csv is the reference output.

The package examples/sma-signal/ recomputes the moving-average trend rule with a buffer day by day: line, market state, trading costs, money-market interest and value curve.

The package examples/rebalancing/ recomputes rebalancing two products to a fixed target weight day by day, in one run by date and one run by date and band: unit counts, equity share, deadline, band and value curve.

The package examples/leverage-model/ recomputes the price of a leveraged product before its launch day by day, with the daily reset of the leverage.

The public repository is https://github.com/Andre0512/letf-strategies.

1. Read the recipe in the package README (README.md) of an example package.
2. Implement the recipe in your own code and run it on input.csv.
3. Check your result against the reference output in output.csv.

To compare the script output line by line: python3 recompute.py input.csv > result.csv, then diff result.csv output.csv; if diff prints nothing, every line matches.

Keep to the invented input; the recipe shows how the numbers are built, nothing more.
